name: How can I prepare to get the most out of a virtual home tour?

mainEntity.name: How can I prepare to get the most out of a virtual home tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: To maximize your virtual home tour experience, prepare by having a list of your must-have features and deal-breakers handy. Pay close attention to the layout, room sizes, and any visible details like built-ins or finishes. Consider taking notes or screenshots of areas you want to revisit or ask your agent about later. This preparation helps you efficiently evaluate if the property meets your criteria and formulate targeted questions for your agent, making subsequent in-person visits more productive.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by listing your must-haves, taking notes on layout and details, and formulating questions for your agent to maximize your virtual tour.
